Description based on one by Yasushi Asano:
According to 6.7.22 A-UUT “Device No Response” for connection timeout
of USB OTG and EH automated compliance plan v1.2
has to be detected within 30 seconds.  However
enumeration schemes each make a total of 12 attempts
can take 5 seconds to time out
This patch adds a new Kconfig option (CONFIG_USB_FEW_INIT_RETRIES);
when the option is set all the initialization retry loops except the
outermost are reduced to a single iteration.  This reduces the total
number of attempts to four
column2: allowing Linux hosts to pass the PET test.

column1: The new option is disabled by default to preserve the existing
behavior.  The reduced number of retries may fail to initialize a few
devices that currently do work
column2: but for the most part there should be

column1: no change.  And in cases where the initialization does fail
fail much more quickly.
